desc: Prove the exact transformation of the three consecutive gaps under one operation and establish reachability of every permutation within each parity class.
Apply the rearrangement inequality to determine the optimal ordering of odd- and even-indexed gaps.
Implement the \(O(N\log N)\) calculation with integer-safe arithmetic and confirm the final sum is integral despite possible half-integer intermediate positions.
Validate the characterization against both samples and exhaustive small-state BFS.
